name: Chapter card: window numeral
when: A new chapter starts and the shot is the hook. A slash wipes the card in; the chapter number rises as a window cut in the card with the chapter's first shot playing inside it, the kicker, a two-line title and the chapter list land beside it, then the camera flies through the numeral into the shot.
anchor: The card wipes in at `in` (put it on the cut into the new chapter); the camera flies into the numeral at `out`.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.number: this chapter's number, one digit (1 to 9): the window numeral, drawn from Inter 900 in both themes as validated
vars.total: how many chapters the video has (2 to 12, at least `number`): the chapter list under the title
vars.title: the chapter title, title case, 20 characters at most; it breaks into two lines at the word nearest the middle, so no word longer than 11 characters
vars.before: optional: the last shot before the card, a video file; it plays full frame and pushes in slightly until the card covers it. Empty: the project's footage shows
vars.after: the chapter's first shot, a video file: it plays at 0.7x speed inside the numeral, then fills the frame
vars.ground: the card's ground: a 1920x1080 still blurred and dimmed to 60 %, baked with ffmpeg (no tint): ffmpeg -i shot.jpg -vf "scale=2112:1188,gblur=sigma=10:steps=3,crop=1920:1080,colorchannelmixer=rr=0.6:gg=0.6:bb=0.6" -q:v 2 ground.jpg
vars.in: seconds after the start: the card wipes in (0.2 s), the numeral rises 0.1 s later (0.5 s)
vars.out: seconds after the start: the text blurs out (0.2 s) and the camera flies through the numeral into the shot (0.55 s); at least 1.3 s after `in`. The scene ends 1.5 s after `out`, the shot full frame

changed: The shots and the card's ground are file values; the numeral is any digit 1 to 9 (outlines baked from Inter 900 like the validated 3, each with its own fly-through point), the title breaks itself into two lines and the chapter list follows `number` / `total`. The progress underline under the list is gone: it had zero width and never showed. The plum backing behind the card is gone (it never showed).
